title: Wise Business pricing - No monthly fee, 0.33%-0.81% FX/transfer fees per corridor
clean_text: Wise Business has no monthly fee or account maintenance charge. FX rates start from 0.33% above mid-market and currency transfer fees start at 0.63%, with transparent corridor-specific rates ranging roughly 0.36%-0.81% based on testing in February 2026. A one-time account setup fee varies by region: free in Hong Kong, $31 in the US, £50 in the UK, $99 SGD in Singapore, and $65 AUD in Australia. Wise shows the exact cost of each transfer before confirmation.
